name: Park Jae-hyun
bio:
Park Jae-hyun's passion for motorsport ignited during his mandatory military service, where he was responsible for maintaining and coordinating vehicle logistics for his unit. This experience, though demanding, revealed his aptitude for organization and resource management, skills he realized could translate directly to the racing world. After his service, he pursued a degree in supply chain management, focusing on optimizing logistics in high-pressure environments.

Jae-hyun's approach to logistics is deeply rooted in meticulous planning and proactive problem-solving. He believes that a well-coordinated logistics operation is the backbone of any successful racing team. He's known for his ability to anticipate potential challenges and develop contingency plans, ensuring that the team always has the right resources at the right place and at the right time. His experience with Mercedes-AMG has helped him to hone his skills and he is quickly becoming an indispensable member of the team.

What sets Jae-hyun apart is his ability to blend his technical understanding with his management skills. He's not just a coordinator; he's a strategist who understands the intricacies of motorsport logistics and is always looking for innovative ways to improve efficiency and reduce costs. He is a truly valuable asset to the Mercedes-AMG team.
